# Design point P003

## Description

A centralized Git hosting service would support collaboration, while clients use GVFS object-transfer semantics to retrieve only the large-repository objects they need. Lightly used repositories could receive fewer physical replicas to reduce fixed redundancy costs, though this trades off some durability or availability and has mixed status.
